simple.summary: מֶזֶו (mezev) means a granary First listed occurrence: Ps 144 13.

definitions.full: H4200. mazu [ מָ֫זוּ ] noun masculine garner (on formation compare Ol § 144 b, 197 b ) — only Plural suffix מְלֵאִים מְזָוֵינוּ Psa 144:13 our garners are full (word inflected as if מְ were radical; compare Ol l.c . I. זוז (Late Hebrew זוז move , Assyrian zâzu, move, rise come forth compare COT gloss.; also be agitated, enraged , VR:64, i, l. 11).
definitions.rootNote: probably from an unused root meaning to gather in;
